what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bangladesh in Greece: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1402 Bangladeshi asylum seekers in Greece, 1.5% of all asylum seekers from Bangladesh.
Refugees from Bangladesh, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Bangladesh in 2005 and 2006, and with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 15 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7065, at the end of 2013; the main years of displacement in the data are 2010, 2013 and 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Greece.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Greece only.
